source.title: A unified framework for semi-supervised dimensionality reduction

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 937423. Direct browser resolution of https://zbmath.org/937423 did not expose a readable record body. Exact-work resolver metadata from MaRDI, Crossref, OpenAlex, HKUST, ResearchGate, and ScienceDirect identified the work as Yangqiu Song, Feiping Nie, Changshui Zhang, and Shiming Xiang, 'A unified framework for semi-supervised dimensionality reduction', DOI 10.1016/j.patcog.2008.01.001, Pattern Recognition 41(9), pages 2789-2799 (2008).

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted / metadata_only, with network_or_dns_failure for local publisher fetches. OpenAlex confirmed the exact title and DOI but reported open_access.is_oa=false, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false. Crossref confirmed the exact DOI/title and listed only Elsevier text-mining and publisher retrieval links. Local curl attempts to the Elsevier text-mining endpoint and ScienceDirect PDF endpoint failed because api.elsevier.com and www.sciencedirect.com could not be resolved from the sandbox.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by zbMATH id, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus authors, exact DOI plus PDF, and the Elsevier PII S003132030800006X. Inspected exact candidates were ScienceDirect article pages, HKUST repository/research-portal pages, ResearchGate, MaRDI, and metadata mirrors. ResearchGate explicitly reported no full text available; HKUST and MaRDI exposed bibliographic metadata or DOI links; ScienceDirect search snippets exposed an abstract, section snippets, references, and an incomplete conclusion fragment rather than a complete readable full-text source.

No document map was produced because no readable primary PDF or full HTML source for the exact zbMATH/DOI work was recovered. Resolver metadata, abstracts, search snippets, link labels, and incomplete section snippets were not used as the technical source.

Candidate extraction was not performed. Per the source-adequacy and no-new-facts gates, questions were not extracted from abstracts, bibliographic metadata, reference lists, resolver records, search snippets, or incomplete publisher snippets.

Extraction stopped before accepted-question generation because the bounded recovery pass did not recover a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing complete problem statements. Accepted output is empty and the run is marked for review with invalid_or_unreadable_input.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/937423.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
